title: Podcast SFERA - Videos
description:
SFERA is an ideal space where all points gravitate toward a single center; a meeting place for local creatives and enthusiasts who are shaping a better living environment. A place that brings together all those who see architecture as a mechanism of social change.

CREATIVE TEAM:

Authors and producers:
Miljan Salata
Igor Mikitišin
